player_prompt.intro:
Tɛmɛna ni Frozen Lake!

I ye 'P' ye kɔnɔ kɛ grid dɛsɛ.
Grid kɛlɛnkɛw:
  ' ' = Frozen kɔnɔ (kɛlɛnkɛ ye kɔnɔ)
  'H' = Hole (i fa ka sɔrɔ!)
  'G' = Lakika (i ka kɛ o lakika!)
  'P' = I kɛlɛnkɛ kɔnɔ

Kɛlɛndɛlen dɔnɔ: up, down, left, right (alama w, a, s, d)
Sɛbɛn kɛlɛndɛlen kɛ: [up], [down], [left], [right] alama [w], [a], [s], [d]

Lakika: I ka kɛlɛ sɔrɔ o kɔnɔ (kɔnɔ kɛ) kɔnɔ kɛ lakika (kɔnɔ kɛ) o sɔrɔ hole dɔ!

invalid_move.unknown_action: Baara min tɛ dɔn '{action}'. A bɛ kɛ sanfɛ, duguma, numan fɛ, kinin fɛ walima w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: I tun b'a fɛ ka taa {action} nka i ye kogo gosi!

outcome.win: I sera ka i laɲini sɔrɔ!
outcome.fell_in_hole: I binna dingɛ kɔnɔ! Ɲɛnamaya banna. I ye {pct}% ta ka taa se laɲini ma.
outcome.turn_limit: I sera i ka yɛlɛma dan ma! Ɲɛnamaya banna. I ye {pct}% taama kɛ fo ka se laɲini yɔrɔ la.
